actual.artifact_policy: Every ref has exact path, sha256, role and media_type fields; path must be normalized repository-relative POSIX, contain no embedded NUL, have at most 4096 characters, use exact case-sensitive on-disk segment spelling, contain no segment ending in a space or dot, exist now, round-trip exactly through resolved repository-relative POSIX spelling, match its normalized SHA-256, and satisfy its role-specific root, suffix and media-type policy. PurePath, resolve, directory listing, is_file, stat, hash and open OSError, ValueError and RuntimeError failures are caught as structured rejection.
actual.boundary: The schema fixture creates no candidate, response map, prediction or physical error proof. Artifact existence cannot establish artifact semantics. The validator does not machine-prove semantic truth, change-evidence equivalence, result-key fitness, script/run provenance equivalence, or source-class/used-for equivalence. The Lane-Q source-only route remains non-admitted; D03/D05/D06/D08, prospective D07 and every parent gate remain open.
actual.canonical_positive_rational_grammar: [1-9][0-9]*(?:/[1-9][0-9]*)? with at most 128 characters, coprime numerator/denominator and slash-form denominator at least 2; denominator-one values use canonical integer spelling. No decimals, whitespace, leading zeros, sign, zero, denominator one in slash form or unreduced form; conversion ValueError is caught.
actual.error_evidence_contract: Exactly six unique error IDs; every canonical positive bound binds an ERROR_SCRIPT .py ref, an ERROR_RUN claims/*/runs/*/result.json ref and a unique top-level result key that exists in that JSON; all (script,run,key) composites are distinct.
